FILE: research/audits/api_inputs/2026-11-13-wave-cluster-completion/wave-compact-source-sampler.md
Prove or decisively falsify this NEW COMPLETE classical endpoint: same native torus and damping, but source support lies in a supplied translated square [-D,D]^2, D a numerical parameter. Arbitrary rational complex weights, including near/nonradiating cancellation, no separation/norm promise. Construct finiteclock poly(n,D,m,B,1/epsilon) full spatial Born sampler. It must compute the source field and proposal, not call an oracle or assume the radiative power is inversepolynomial. Exact quotient family is alreadymatched; cover ALL compact sources, not another exact-divisible variant.
Parent mechanism to attack first: ||u||>=||f||/8. Evaluate a polynomial-size near patch directly; far from the source use actual-lattice stationary phase on the SUM, retaining F evaluated at the stationary point and damping. A leading error of order poly(D,m)||f|| r^-3/2 has square-summable tail <=poly(D,m)/R, so a radiusR=poly(D,m,1/epsilon) might pay all cancellation without an L-dependent inverseaccuracy. Then use finite-degree algebraic-curve angular density and known radial envelope to sample the radiative field. Near-zero radiative amplitude and near/far interference must not cost inverse radiative power. Periodicimages are coherent and cannot be independently sampled or dropped.
The attached Markov source is a real-plane polynomial theorem, NOT a theorem for Laurent trigonometric functions on the torus curve; denominator/pole bookkeeping is required. Rational halfangle curve 1-3t²-3s²-7t²s²=0 is smooth compact, t=tan(p/2),s=tan(q/2). Multiplying by denominators changes relative norms exponentially inD, so a naive polynomial conversion fails. You may derive a paid rational version or another explicit proposal. Charge coefficients, elementary functions, tails, normalization, acceptance, random bits and output. No implementation or finite scans. One hardest falsifier first, then full algorithm/proof if it survives.

Native task and current verified state, Nov13. This is a NEW mechanism-specific request, not a retry of an EMPTY failed general-superposition call. Reports advisory; parent independently checks material claims. No tools, repository archives, credentials, free oracles, normalization advice, finite-example promotions or novelty claims. State exact quantifiers, BIT clock, resources, classical baselines and falsifiers. Give a constructive endpoint or the precise failed new operation; do not just list familiar barriers.

INPUT n>=2,L=2^n, torus Z_L², K=4I-Tx-Tx^-1-Ty-Ty^-1, Bop=I-K, A=Bop+i/L. Explicit distinct source sites x_j and rational complex w_j total bit length B, f=sum w_j delta_xj nonzero. OUTPUT spatial Born law |u(x)|²/||u||²,u=A^-1f, TVepsilon. Target poly(n,m,B,1/epsilon) finiteclock. Symbol b(p,q)=-3+2cos p+2cos q. Fullgrid L² work is not poly(n). Generic QLSS pays condition number L. No QRAM, Green evaluator/sampler, inverse, norm, shellcount or hidden support given.

Verified facts: with G=A^-1delta0, L/512<=Z0=||G||²<=128L. Five-source f=Bop delta0 gives u=delta0-iG/L, ||u||²=1-Z0/L², Re u0=||u||², P_u0>=1-128/L. Usual source LCU success is ||u||²/(||w||1² Z0), hence Theta(1/L) for fiveweights(-3,1,1,1,1); any fixed C/L resonant band has spatialTV approaching1. Full off-resonant field must be retained. Positive weights and fixed source separation also do not prevent exponentially small Gram ratio: binomial arrays at fixed dyadic spacing yield ratio O(1/L) with poly(n) sites/bits. These are classically easy counterfamilies, not hardness.

There is a reviewed written all-mode m=1 quantum compiler using regular lattice levelset charts, dyadic strip covers, known-size padded windows and clean uncomputation, poly(n,log1/epsilon), constant success. Do not rederive it or substitute a single frequency sample for an inverse QFT. A proposed classical m=1 match is undergoing independent final proof audit. Exact infinite-lattice residue formula for a=max(|y1|,|y2|),d=min: g_eta(a,d)= -i/(4pi) integral_-pi^pi exp(i*a*p_eta(q)+i*d*q)/sin(p_eta(q)) dq, p_eta=acos(3/2-cos q-i eta/2),Im p_eta>0. Exact periodization G_L(x)=sum_z g_(1/L)(x+Lz), coarse tail |g_eta(y)|<=2/eta exp(-eta||y||1/16). For the single-source task a fixed contour plus uniform stationary phase can give leading term and absolute remainder C a^-3/2 with uniform eta, and |g|<=C/sqrt(1+a); these estimates must be proved wherever used, not imported from an agent ACCEPT label. Periodicimages |z|<=O(n+log1/epsilon) pay coarse truncation. Kernel finiteclock depends polynomially on inverse requested scaled error, not yet logarithmically.

EXACT deflation is paid: P=-3+X+X^-1+Y+Y^-1. Ordinary Laurent exact-divisibility can be tested with a polynomial-explicit quotient by gap-decomposition over Q(i). XY P has degree3, nonsquare quadratic discriminant (X²-5X+1)(X²-X+1), and is nonbinomial. AKS2006 actualCor2.5 threshold uses 5^6, NOT56; safe gap2^27 B for total coefficientbitsB. SplitY thenX into atmostm small boxes, divide each exactly, recombine shiftedquotients. Output support s=poly(m,B), BITpoly(n,m,B); nonzero-remainder full normalform can have exponential output and is not granted. Torus cuts need handling: if h has promised support<=S, try(2S+1)² shiftedwindows, or fullgrid whenL<=2S+1. If f=Bop*h then ||u||²=||h||²-eta²||A^-1h||² and TV(P_u,P_h)<=sqrt(128s/L); largeL samplesh, otherwise fullgrid polynomial1/epsilon. Thus exactdivisible sparsequotient sources already classicallymatched. Near-divisible F=P+L^-2 is not paid by a binary exactdivisibilitytest.

Proposed NEW operation: separate compact source clusters into a directly sampled local field and a radiative angular field, with all cancellation and finite torus images paid. General source clustering is not automatically polynomial: merging clusters until separation exceeds a polynomial of their diameter can square diameters each merge. Do not assume an arbitrary sparse set has bounded-diameter well-separated clusters. A global conditional norm ratio is not a theorem. A restricted compact-cluster algorithm is useful only if completely paid and explicitly scoped.
